title: The infinitesimal lifting criterion for formally smooth morphisms of algebraic spaces
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma contains the substantive implication of the infinitesimal lifting criterion for algebraic spaces: a morphism that is locally of finite presentation and formally smooth is smooth. The proof passes to a surjective etale chart, interprets formal smoothness of the map of charts through the lifting property, and then verifies smoothness by exhibiting the vanishing of the relevant obstruction, reducing the cohomological input to the affine case. Passing the lifting condition through the chart and then converting it into the vanishing statement is the work that cannot be replaced by a citation. Retained author proof at lines 4859-4935.
